events.title: House scheduled to meet Monday, April 20, at 12:00 p.m. Eastern
events.official_text: next legislative day convenes 20260420T12:00

events.title: House adjourned
events.official_text: The House adjourned pursuant to a previous special order. The next meeting is scheduled for 12:00 p.m. on April 20, 2026.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: On motion to adjourn Agreed to by voice vote.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: Mr. Scott, Austin moved that the House do now adjourn.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: Mr. Scott, Austin asked unanimous consent That, when the House adjourns on Friday, April 17, 2026, it adjourn to meet on Monday, April 20, 2026, at noon for Morning-Hour debate and 2:00 p.m. for legislative business. Agreed to without objection.

events.title: House floor action on H.R. 8322
events.official_text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

events.title: House floor action on H.R. 8322
events.official_text: On passage Passed without objection.

events.title: House floor action on H.R. 8322
events.official_text: Considered by unanimous consent. H.R. 8322 — "To amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 through April 30, 2026, and for other purposes."

events.title: House floor action on H.R. 8322
events.official_text: Mr. Scott, Austin asked unanimous consent to discharge from committee and consider.

events.title: House floor action on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

events.title: House floor recorded the result of roll call 124 on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: On agreeing to the resolution Failed by recorded vote: 197 - 228 (Roll no. 124).

events.title: House floor recorded the result of roll call 123 on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: On agreeing to the Scott, Austin amendment; Failed by the Yeas and Nays: 200 - 220 (Roll no. 123).

events.title: House floor recorded the result of roll call 122 on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: On ordering the previous question on the amendment and the resolution Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 211 - 210 (Roll no. 122).

events.title: House floor action on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: An amendment, offered by Mr. Scott, Austin, to strike the first section after the resolving clause and insert a new paragraph providing for the consideration of H.R. 8035, title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978.

events.title: House floor action on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H. Res. 1175.

events.title: House floor action on H.Res. 1175
events.official_text: Considered as privileged matter. H. Res. 1175 — "Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 8035) to amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 through October 20, 2027, and for other purposes."

events.title: House returned from a recess
events.official_text: The House convened, returning from a recess continuing the legislative day of April 16.

events.title: House went into recess
events.official_text: The Speaker announced that the House do now recess. The next meeting is subject to the call of the Chair.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: The Speaker laid before the House a message from the President transmitting a notification stating that the national emergency declared in Proclamation 10371 of April 21, 2022, with respect to the Russian Federation and the emergency authority relating to the regulation of the anchorage and movement of Russian-affiliated vessels to United States ports, is to continue in effect beyond April 21, 2026 - referred to the Committee on Foreign Affairs and ordered to be printed (H. Doc. 119-149).

events.title: House floor action on H.Con.Res. 40
events.official_text: Considered pursuant to a previous order. H. Con. Res. 40 — "Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran."

events.title: House floor action on H.Con.Res. 40
events.official_text: Consideration initiated pursuant to a previous order.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: ONE MINUTE SPEECHES - The House proceeded with one minute speeches, which by direction of the Chair would be limited to 15 per side of the aisle.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE - The Chair designated Ms. Ocasio-Cortez to lead the Members in reciting the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: The Speaker announced approval of the Journal. Pursuant to clause 1, rule I, the Journal stands approved.

events.title: House floor proceedings entry
events.official_text: Today's prayer was offered by the House Chaplain, Chaplain Margaret Grun Kibben.
